This is Table 14 symbol e's branch 'Input files and input-output files (unit media)', item 1: when the current unit is the last or only unit there is no unit swap, the current volume pointer is unchanged, and the file position indicator is set so that no next or previous logical record exists. Its antecedent needs a physical file ON UNIT MEDIA, i.e. GR2 category (b) or (c). The previous NOT-IMPLEMENTED grade was correct while the category placement was an undocumented comment; it is now a named, total, documented model - `FileConnector.Category` is abstract, no connector answers (b) or (c), the placement is FORCED by 9.1.13.2 item 6's non-reel/unit definition of the '07' this compiler reports, and it is stated for users in docs/CONFORMANCE.md 7 (Annex A.1 item 24), which is exactly the discharge the previous note said would make this branch legitimately vacuous. Every CLOSE ... UNIT therefore takes symbol e's THIRD branch (non-unit media), adjudicated at GR-14.9.6.4-L2.2. NO WITNESS IS CONSTRUCTIBLE, positive or negative, so 1(c)'s covering test is unmeetable rather than unmet. The vacuity is CONTINGENT and guarded: CloseTable14Tests.Category_PlacesEverySupportedConnectorKind and .ReachableCategories_NeedNoUnitStructuredSymbol fail the moment a connector answers (b) or (c), and FileRegistry.CloseByFormat refuses a cell needing symbols a/b/d/f loudly rather than performing a subset of it - at which point this row must be re-adjudicated, not inherit its closure.
